Headline: Nova Minerals Releases September 2026 Corporate Presentation on Estelle Gold and Antimony Supply Chain
Summary: Nova Minerals (ASX:NVA) has issued its September 2026 Corporate Presentation, detailing its focus on developing the Estelle Gold and Critical Minerals Project in Alaska. The presentation also highlights the company's progress in establishing a U.S. domestic antimony supply chain, fully funded by a US$43.4 million award from the U.S. Department of War, with production targeted for 2027. The Estelle project is located within the Tintina Gold Belt, which boasts over 220 million ounces of documented gold endowment.

Headline: Morgan Stanley Sees Marathon Petroleum (MPC) Breaking into New Highs
Summary: Morgan Stanley has raised its price target for Marathon Petroleum (MPC) to $453 from $265, reiterating an 'Overweight' rating, driven by an anticipated extended period of high global refining margins due to ongoing geopolitical tensions. Despite the stock's significant gains this year and potential risks associated with elevated Q2 profits and maximum refinery utilization, analysts believe the rally has further upside. The company's shareholder return strategy and stake in MPLX also contribute to the positive outlook, although market sentiment shows hedge fund interest with some caution about AI stock alternatives.
